status: Frozen before predictions; no model tuning
scientific_endpoint: Rank reported BglB functional thermal midpoints after 30-minute heat challenge; folding ddG is used as an uncalibrated ranking score
scope: One enzyme with author-prepared apo backbone; not equilibrium folding ddG, physical melting-temperature calibration, activity prediction or enzyme-family generalization

data.discrepancy: The supplied table contains 128 mutants plus BglB WT; the article describes 129 mutants and 79 mutant thermal midpoints. Every supplied row is retained, without inventing the absent variant.

model_context.input_type: Author-supplied prepared apo coordinates from supplementary archive file 8504015; no restricted modeling software executed
model_context.numbering: Author prepared residues 1–445 exactly match all 128 table mutation identities; current deposited 2O9P uses different numbering and engineered background residues
model_context.terminal_context: Observed/model scaffold excludes unresolved N-terminal expression-tag/terminal residues in deposited 2O9P; no full experimental-construct atomistic claim
model_context.source_differences: Direct deposited 2O9P mismatches H373R wild type; original unmodified structure and failed check retained

overlap.queries: Full deposited entity, observed construct and author-prepared construct
overlap.limit: No detectable sequence overlap at this threshold; ProteinMPNN structure pretraining and remote fold similarity remain unresolved

primary_analysis.cohort: All 78 finite mutant thermal midpoints, excluding the WT control
primary_analysis.score: Negative predicted ddG; larger score ranks as more stable
primary_analysis.uncertainty: 2000 bootstrap replicates resampling mutated positions with replacement and retaining all variants within each selected position; percentile 95% interval
primary_analysis.positive_ranking_criterion: Lower endpoint of the position-bootstrap 95% interval is greater than zero

shortlist_analysis.measured_cohort: Top 10 of the 78 measured variants ranked by negative ddG, ties by mutant name
shortlist_analysis.baseline: Uniform random shortlist of 10 from the same 78 variants; exact hypergeometric upper-tail probability
shortlist_analysis.enrichment_criterion: Top-10 verified gain count exceeds random expectation with one-sided hypergeometric p <= 0.05
shortlist_analysis.full_screen: Also show top 10 of all 128 variants, with missing midpoint, nonexpression and censored activity retained explicitly; no imputation
shortlist_analysis.observed_activity_retention: Report separately whether measured catalytic efficiency is at least 50% of WT (87000 M^-1 min^-1); <10 is censored low and NA stays unknown

assay_conditions.buffer: 50 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 25 mM EDTA, pH 7.50
assay_conditions.source_grid_ambiguity: Article states 8 temperatures in 2.5 C increments between 30 and 50 C; those descriptions differ in point count. Analysis uses reported fitted midpoints and does not reconstruct raw fits.
assay_conditions.substrate: pNPG activity readout after heat challenge

cost: Measure fresh workflow wall time and complete provider/worker timing; installation and resource download remain separately reported. No comparison of inference seconds to nanoseconds of physical MD as a speedup.
